title: Kestrel Auto Finance Credit Policy — Stipulation Cushion on Vehicle Purchase Agreements Cash Down
content:
**Clause.** On an order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements financed through Kestrel Auto Finance, a stipulation cushion is added to the cash down while the verifications the approval requires before signing (the approval's stipulations) are not yet completed. The tier and the verification state are those of the order's approved contract in Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts.

| Tier of the approved contract | Required verifications completed | Stipulation cushion |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Finance Tier D or Tier E | no | $400.00 (the deep-subprime cushion) |
| Kestrel Finance Tier C | no | $250.00 (the Tier C cushion) |
| Kestrel Finance Tier C, Tier D or Tier E | yes | none |
| Kestrel Finance Tier B, Tier A or Tier A+ | — | none |

The cushion is added to the cash down after the down payment credits have been subtracted from the required down payment and that difference held at no less than zero; the sum is rounded half up to the cent.

**Hypothetical cases.**
- Tier E, verifications outstanding, required down payment $3000.00 less credits of $3600.00: the difference is held at $0.00, and the cushion adds $400.00 to it.
- Tier C, verifications outstanding, required down payment less credits $1100.00: with the cushion, $1350.00.
- The same Tier C order after the verifications are recorded as completed: no cushion.
